scope: Current t6 is unchanged and remains the sole active queue. This note reads frozen source and closed historical proofs only. No active t6 outcomes/metrics, labels/prediction arrays, API ledgers or private config were read; no fits/API/tests/source mutations.

dataflow_facts.fact: Primary split uses make_split(seed42). All search workers evaluate on that same primary validation partition. ordered(records) ranks by that metric; planner_context forwards measured scalar/per-class feedback to Qwen. Primary validation labels therefore participate in adaptive model/feature/parameter selection.

HPO nested_partition subsets only primary fitting_rows, makes an inner split(seed137), and remaps local indices to original positions. Trial objective/study.tell uses inner worker metrics. This prevents primary validation labels entering the HPO trial objective, but does not make the full adaptive procedure primary-blind.

Time strategy dispatches make_split to make_time_split; seed is ignored for time. Offset0 validates the latest available period; offset1 validates the immediately preceding period. Nested HPO sees only periods before the primary period, so its latest inner period is exactly the confirmation period.

Confirmation is not evaluation-only: candidate means(primary,confirmation) choose the final recipe; candidate iteration trees use both runs; blend weights are searched over both cuts. The complete procedure consumes both sets of labels through metrics.

EDA target_summary/class_counts are computed over the entire supplied train.csv before splitting. They are full-input aggregates, not fitting-only estimates. A real external holdout must be physically excluded from this agent train input, not merely marked by another NPZ.
Final selected recipe refits on all supplied train rows for deployment. This is appropriate for a genuinely unlabeled test set; it does not turn selected local search scores into blind estimates.
